guide.summary: Restricted Mode: up to 25 outside users (self-serve, wait none); Public app for any YNAB user (app review, wait 2-4 weeks).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Restricted Mode: up to 25 outside users (self-serve, wait none). Hardest: Public app for any YNAB user (app review, wait 2-4 weeks).

composio.note: Composio lists OAuth2 as managed for YNAB. Managed apps show Composio's name on the consent screen and share quota across Composio users.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, since Composio provides a managed YNAB app. For launch under your own brand, with dedicated quota and review-based removal of the user cap, you need your own YNAB OAuth app.
reasons: Consent screen shows your brand instead of Composio's
Dedicated rate-limit quota instead of shared quota
Review and Restricted Mode removal apply to your own app
Listing on Works with YNAB needs your own reviewed app

scenarios.label: Restricted Mode: up to 25 outside users
scenarios.when_this_applies: Pilot or early access where no more than 25 users other than the app owner connect.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: Restricted Mode applies automatically on creation (c1, c2).

scenarios.approval: No review while staying within the 25-token cap; the app runs in Restricted Mode.
extras: 25 tokens for users other than the owner

modifiers.note: 25 tokens for users other than the owner

scenarios.label: Public app for any YNAB user
scenarios.when_this_applies: Production agent where more than 25 outside users connect.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; privacy policy and review form included

scenarios.approval: YNAB reviews the app against the API Terms of Service and OAuth Application Requirements before removing Restricted Mode.
extras: Rules on what you may build or say

modifiers.note: Rules on what you may build or say

prerequisites.title: A YNAB account
prerequisites.detail: OAuth apps are created while signed in, under Account Settings then Developer Settings.

prerequisites.title: Public privacy policy
prerequisites.detail: It must explain how API data is handled, stored, secured and retained, how users can delete data, and show a Last Updated date. Show its URL in the OAuth client config and in the app.

prerequisites.title: Compliant name and branding
prerequisites.detail: The app name and domain may not include YNAB unless preceded by 'for', and artwork must differ from YNAB's. Add a non-affiliation disclaimer.

steps.title: Create the OAuth app in YNAB
steps.detail: Sign in, open Developer Settings, click New Application, enter details and save. Copy the Client ID and Client Secret.
steps.done_when: You have a Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Copy redirect URI from Composio
steps.detail: Take the callback URL from the Composio dashboard and check it matches exactly what you register in YNAB.
steps.done_when: Redirect URI is saved in the YNAB app.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the ynab auth config through Composio's API with your own client ID and secret.

steps.title: Draft and publish privacy policy
steps.detail: An agent can draft it from the stated requirements; you publish it and add its URL in the app.

steps.title: Submit the review request form
steps.detail: Request review via YNAB's form once the app complies with the Terms and requirements.

steps.title: Wait for YNAB review
steps.detail: YNAB emails confirmation when Restricted Mode is removed.

traps.title: 25-user cap blocks new sign-ups
traps.detail: After 25 outside users, new authorizations are prohibited until review ends Restricted Mode. Start the review before launch.

traps.title: Short-lived tokens
traps.detail: Access tokens expire after 2 hours. Implicit grant gives no refresh token, so use the authorization code grant to refresh without re-prompting.

traps.title: Rate limit is per token
traps.detail: Each token gets 200 requests per hour in a rolling window, and exceeding it returns 429. YNAB may change limits at its discretion.

traps.title: Access can be suspended
traps.detail: YNAB may suspend API access at any time without notice.

blockers.symptom: Authorization screen shows a message and refuses new users
blockers.what_it_means: The Restricted Mode 25-token limit has been reached.
blockers.what_to_do: Request a review through YNAB's form and wait 2-4 weeks.
blockers.agent_can_help: Check the app against the Terms and privacy policy requirements before you submit.

blockers.what_it_means: The token was issued with the read-only scope.
blockers.what_to_do: Request a scope that allows writes only if the agent needs it.
blockers.agent_can_help: Audit which tools need write access.

open_questions: Does the rate limit differ for reviewed apps? Ask YNAB API support.
Do review outcomes include rejection criteria beyond the stated policies? Ask via the review form contact.
